title: tk-studio headless status block
description: Terminal JSON block ending every headless studio run (AD-11). BMad-style: status + intent + artifacts, with reason on anything other than a clean completion.

artifacts.description: Paths or identifiers of artifacts produced. Empty for read-only runs.

reason.description: Required (non-null) when status is 'partial' or 'blocked': the guard hit, the ambiguity, or the failing step.
